definitions.gloss: rough skin; skin irritation; chapped skin
definitions.explanation: condition where the skin becomes rough, dry, or irritated due to weather, stress, diet, or other factors

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{肌荒|はだあ}れしやすい。
examples.english: Skin gets rough easily in winter.

examples.japanese: {肌荒|はだあ}れを{防|ふせ}ぐために{保湿|ほしつ}クリームを{塗|ぬ}る。
examples.english: I apply moisturizing cream to prevent rough skin.

examples.japanese: ストレスで{肌荒|はだあ}れがひどくなった。
examples.english: My skin irritation got worse from stress.

notes:
A compound of {肌|はだ} (skin) + {荒|あ}れ (roughness). Describes skin that has become rough, dry, red, or irritated.

COMMON CAUSES:
- {乾燥|かんそう}: dryness (especially in winter)
- ストレス: stress
- {睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}: lack of sleep
- {食生活|しょくせいかつ}の{乱|みだ}れ: poor diet
- {花粉|かふん}: pollen (seasonal allergies)

VERB FORMS:
- {肌|はだ}が{荒|あ}れる: skin becomes rough (intransitive)
- {肌荒|はだあ}れする: to have rough skin (suru-verb)
- {肌荒|はだあ}れを{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent rough skin
- {肌荒|はだあ}れを{治|なお}す: to treat rough skin

RELATED TERMS:
- {乾燥肌|かんそうはだ}: dry skin (skin type)
- {敏感肌|びんかんはだ}: sensitive skin
- {保湿|ほしつ}: moisturizing
- スキンケア: skincare
